missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Кресло' is the neuter nominative predicate noun. 'Удобное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A basic praise statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Кресло' is the accusative direct object of 'купили'; this neuter noun keeps its nominative form. 'Новое' agrees in the neuter accusative. A shopping statement.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В кресле' uses the prepositional form 'кресле' after 'в'. 'Мягком' agrees in the neuter prepositional. A cosy scene.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Кресла' is the genitive after 'у', marking whose leg broke. 'Ножка' is the nominative subject of 'сломалась'. A repair statement.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К креслу' uses the dative 'креслу' after 'к' to show movement toward. 'Старому' agrees in the neuter dative. A movement phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 'Креслом' is the instrumental after 'рядом с', showing what the table stands beside. 'Стол' is the nominative subject. A spatial description.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Кресла' is the genitive singular required by 'два'. 'Кожаных' takes the plural genitive after the numeral. A furnishing statement.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Кресла' is the neuter nominative plural subject of 'стоят'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural. A pricing complaint.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Кресел' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. Note the fleeting vowel inserted before the zero ending. A store description.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Креслами' is the instrumental plural after 'между'. 'Лампа' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'. A spatial description.
